description: Reviewed threshold and resource budget configuration for the pages performance budget gate (issue #229). Lighthouse lab metrics (LCP, CLS, TBT) are measured under the pinned mobile profile documented in run_pages_lighthouse.py. TBT is a lab proxy only and is never labelled INP. Resource budgets are verified against the checked-in site/ tree; sizes are uncompressed byte counts unless stated otherwise.

lcp.description: Largest Contentful Paint — primary loading metric.

cls.description: Cumulative Layout Shift — primary visual-stability metric.

tbt.description: Total Blocking Time — lab proxy only, never labelled INP.

performance_score.description: Secondary evidence; the primary gates are LCP, CLS, and TBT.

html.description: Per-page HTML document size (uncompressed). Current max is site/index.html at 17,922 bytes.

css.description: Total CSS size across all pages (uncompressed). Current is site/styles.css at 26,356 bytes.

javascript.description: Total JavaScript size across all pages (uncompressed). Current is site/site.js at 444 bytes.

images.description: Total image size per page (uncompressed). The checker scans the entire site/ tree for all image files (png, jpg, jpeg, gif, svg, webp, avif) and sums their sizes. Current is site/og.png at 1,437,709 bytes (~1.4 MB). og.png is an Open Graph metadata image referenced via , not loading-critical for LCP or CLS — it is never rendered as a visible on any page.

third_party.description: No third-party requests are permitted. All assets are first-party under /pycc/.

unexpected_requests.description: No unexpected runtime requests beyond the page document and its declared first-party assets.

allowed_assets.description: First-party assets permitted in Lighthouse network requests, relative to the project path /pycc/. The page document itself is always allowed. Any first-party request not in this list (and not the page document) is counted as an unexpected request.

compressed_size_treatment.description: Resource budgets specify uncompressed byte counts. GitHub Pages serves content uncompressed over HTTP for static HTML/CSS/JS, so uncompressed sizes are the served sizes. If a future deployment adds gzip/brotli compression, the compressed transfer size must also be documented and must not exceed the uncompressed budget.

asset_dimensions_and_loading.description: Asset dimensions and loading behavior are checked where they affect LCP or CLS. og.png is an OG metadata image and does not affect LCP/CLS because it is never rendered as a visible . No visible images are present on any canonical page, so there are no LCP image candidates or CLS image-reservation concerns.
